title: Bidirectional model seed file for Claude + UI model management
description:
## Problem

With the new UI-based model management, Claude can no longer add models by editing code files. Previously:
- Models defined in `packages/ai/src/models.ts`
- Claude edits file → model added
- Simple, versioned, reviewable

Now:
- Models managed via Admin UI → stored in Convex DB
- Claude can't interact with UI
- User must manually add models

## Solution: CLI Command for Model Management

Simple CLI script that Claude can run to add/update models directly in the database.

```bash
# Add a new model
bun run model:add --id "openai:gpt-6" --name "GPT-6" --provider "openai" \
  --context 128000 --input 2.5 --output 10

# Or with JSON for complex config
bun run model:add --json '{"modelId": "openai:gpt-6", "name": "GPT-6", ...}'
```

### Why This Approach

| Aspect | CLI Command | Bidirectional Sync |
|--------|-------------|-------------------|
| Implementation | ~50 lines | Complex sync logic |
| Time to add model | Seconds | PR → merge → deploy |
| Complexity | Minimal | High (conflict resolution, formatting) |
| Fits current arch | Yes (DB is source of truth) | Fighting against it |

### "But no PR review?"

- Models are config, not security-critical code
- Bad model = doesn't work or wrong pricing → fix via UI
- `modelHistory` table provides full audit trail
- Can always add models via seed.ts for bulk/reviewed changes

## Implementation

### Phase 1: Core CLI Script

**File:** `scripts/model-cli.ts`

```typescript
#!/usr/bin/env bun
import { ConvexHttpClient } from "convex/browser";
import { api } from "@blah-chat/backend/convex/_generated/api";
import { parseArgs } from "util";

const client = new ConvexHttpClient(process.env.CONVEX_URL!);

const { values, positionals } = parseArgs({
  args: process.argv.slice(2),
  options: {
    id: { type: "string" },
    name: { type: "string" },
    provider: { type: "string" },
    context: { type: "string" },
    input: { type: "string" },  // cost per million
    output: { type: "string" }, // cost per million
    json: { type: "string" },   // full config as JSON
    // ... other fields
  },
  allowPositionals: true,
});

const command = positionals[0]; // add, update, list, deprecate

async function main() {
  switch (command) {
    case "add":
      const model = values.json 
        ? JSON.parse(values.json)
        : buildModelFromArgs(values);
      await client.mutation(api.models.mutations.create, model);
      console.log(`✓ Added model: ${model.modelId}`);
      break;
    
    case "list":
      const models = await client.query(api.models.queries.list, {});
      console.table(models.map(m => ({ id: m.modelId, name: m.name, status: m.status })));
      break;
    
    case "deprecate":
      await client.mutation(api.models.mutations.deprecate, { modelId: values.id });
      console.log(`✓ Deprecated: ${values.id}`);
      break;
  }
}

main().catch(console.error);
```

### Phase 2: Package.json Scripts

```json
{
  "scripts": {
    "model:add": "bun scripts/model-cli.ts add",
    "model:list": "bun scripts/model-cli.ts list",
    "model:update": "bun scripts/model-cli.ts update",
    "model:deprecate": "bun scripts/model-cli.ts deprecate"
  }
}
```

### Phase 3: Claude-Friendly Documentation

Add to CLAUDE.md:

```markdown
## Adding New Models

Use the CLI to add models directly to the database:

\`\`\`bash
# Quick add with essential fields
bun run model:add --id "provider:model-name" --name "Display Name" \
  --provider "provider" --context 128000 --input 2.5 --output 10

# Full config via JSON
bun run model:add --json '{
  "modelId": "openai:gpt-6",
  "provider": "openai", 
  "name": "GPT-6",
  "contextWindow": 200000,
  "inputCost": 2.5,
  "outputCost": 10,
  "capabilities": ["vision", "function-calling"],
  "status": "active"
}'

# List all models
bun run model:list

# Deprecate a model
bun run model:deprecate --id "openai:gpt-4"
\`\`\`
```

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `bun run model:add` creates model in DB
- [ ] `bun run model:list` shows all models
- [ ] `bun run model:update` updates existing model
- [ ] `bun run model:deprecate` soft-deletes model
- [ ] JSON input supported for complex configs
- [ ] Clear error messages for validation failures
- [ ] CLAUDE.md updated with usage instructions

## Files to Create/Modify

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `scripts/model-cli.ts` | Main CLI script |
| `package.json` | Add npm scripts |
| `CLAUDE.md` | Document model management for Claude |

## Estimated Effort

~30 minutes implementation
